description: This file implements a platform-independent factory function for creating a Slap Owo Loac object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It provides a constructor wrapper function 'SlapCreateOwoLoac' that calls the underlying 'SlapOwoLoacCreate' function to instantiate the object. The file includes licensing information, module description, and a single creation function.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapCreateOwoLoac(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: A factory function invoked to create a new Slap Owo Loac object, returning a handle to the created object.
